title: Why Slow Drains Happen: The Root Cause in Drainage Systems
description: Understanding the root cause of a slow-running drain is essential for proper troubleshooting. Often, the issue is not a complete blockage, but rather a progressive buildup of organic matter, grease, and soap scum along the interior walls of the pipe. As this layer thickens, the effective internal diameter of the pipe shrinks, restricting water flow and catching debris. By identifying whether a drainage issue is localized to a single fixture or affecting multiple lines, professional plumbers can determine the exact location of the restriction before reaching for tools or chemicals, protecting the plumbing infrastructure.
